title: We Create Tomorrow: karaoke software for the anthem of Trường Kinh tế, Đại học Cần Thơ
description: Web karaoke application for two anthem lyrics of Trường Kinh tế, Đại học Cần Thơ (School of Economics, Can Tho University) — a Vietnamese version ("Chúng ta cùng đi") and an English version ("We Create Tomorrow"). Displays time-synced lyrics, instant language switching, and a sheet-music view. Built with TypeScript, React, Vite, and Tailwind CSS.
